name: Runemaster audit #2250: Harnessing Leylines stacks Harnessed Leylines every 1 sec, up to 10
contract: Harnessing Leylines 704139: 'You now gain a stack of Harnessed Leylines every 1 sec for [duration]. After the
duration, the stacks reset.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (23),
PASSIVE|DO_NOT_DISPLAY only. Helper 804316 'Harnessed Leylines' Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108),
MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints0 2 with DieSides 1 = +3% per stack, StackAmount 10,
EffectSpellClassMask[2] 393216 (0x60000) on family 38, which includes the 0x20000 bit independently confirmed
by runemaster-advanced-magi.json to select Elemental Burst (802202 and ranks). Both
SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL and SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER are generic engine paths
(AuraEffect::PeriodicTick, the spellmod system); no occurrence of 704139/804316 exists in src/server/coa/.
Expected: learning 704139 applies its own infinite aura immediately; one stack of 804316 appears after ~1s,
grows over time and caps at 10; Elemental Burst 802202's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifier on a 1000 base rises by 3%
per stack up to +30% at 10 stacks; SpellDuration.dbc id 21 (DurationIndex 21) is Duration -1, so 704139
stays active (permanent aura, GetDuration() == -1) rather than expiring while the character remains idle.
